subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'LTRH' is coded as '58' and 'NBZW' is coded as '65'. How is 'GSCE' coded in the given language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2670e84d57d8f3a0b32ba38d09d05a2c6cf49319e5d8eba39c7f1d3137f99525.png] 

The logic followed here is,

'LTRH' is coded as '58'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51bc3772a3a295610018849f6810c16d18f949b3625b49a188ce291b34777dab.png] 

'NBZW' is coded as '65'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/219fb2afd8d4fe5f7b9e8621c280972569b81f11042624a2af442ffd5034f05f.png] 

Similarly 'GSCE' is coded as 34

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df97362ac793f433e7e6d218880c8ac8012d85cbb3fcc7a2ace8c79d3e0fa175.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
